title: Chapter 165 Peace Talks Between The Two Countries
content:
Chapter 165 Peace Talks Between The Two Countries

In the early morning of the next day, the gate of Jidu, which had been closed for a long time, opened a narrow side door amidst a creaking sound, and a group of more than ten envoys walked out from the inside.

After walking for a while, this group of people arrived outside the barracks under the guard of a group of Yuguo soldiers, and showed their envoy's seal, announcing that they wanted to see the commander of Yuguo.

Among the large tents of the military camp, this one is located in the center of the military camp, and it is also the largest in size and the most luxurious in decoration. It is now the commander of the whole army of the Imperial Kingdom, their majesty the Emperor!

At this moment, in Xingyuan, Zhong Yu was worrying about his ministers, discussing the next strategy, how to deal with Yan Kingdom, and when to retreat!

"Report, Your Majesty, the envoys from the Kingdom of Yan came and said they wanted to see the commander-in-chief of the army. I wonder how Your Majesty should respond?" Zhong Yu and the others who were discussing were suddenly interrupted by the guard's report, and they all looked up. Xiang's line outside the gate.

"Oh, the envoys from Yan Kingdom are here. It seems that yesterday's visit to the capital was effective? King Yan, this cowardly fellow, can't bear the pressure I bring!" chuckled , Zhong Yu said cheerfully, he couldn't stop being happy when he heard the good news.

"It's all His Majesty's sages. I have long expected that King Yan is as timid as a mouse, so it will have such a miraculous effect. His Majesty's wisdom is as deep as the sea, and his majesty and strategy are hard to match!" Hearing that His Majesty the Emperor was so happy, The brows that had been frowned before were also relaxed. Many ministers would not let this opportunity go, and quickly flattered.

"Okay, you don't need to flatter anymore, guards, go and tell the envoys of Yan Kingdom to come in!" Zhong Yu stopped the ministers from flattering, and said with a smile.

"Oh, by the way, wait for the many lovers, don't reveal the news that I am the emperor of Yuguo, just say, just say that I am the prince of Yuguo, the brother of Yuguo Emperor, His Highness King Jing!" The guard was about to go out, Zhong Yu hurriedly Thinking about it, I still plan to travel around the Central Plains, travel around, check the reality of the world, see that it is a plan of various schools of thought, how can I expose myself as the emperor now?

If you really want to spread the word, all forces in the world will come to try to control yourself, and then use it to control Yuguo, and it will definitely be impossible to travel by yourself.

Therefore, he hurriedly told the many guards and ministers to prevent them from accidentally revealing their identities and making their plans to go out for fun impossible.

"Yes, the ministers must be careful not to expose His Majesty's identity. You are not His Majesty the Emperor of Yuguo, but His Majesty's brother, Your Highness Prince Jing!" Many ministers and guards said in unison.

"Well, it's good for you to understand, it's good for you to understand, you have to be considerate... Oh no, it's Gu's painstaking efforts!" Zhong Yu almost slipped his mouth when he was talking, and quickly changed his words.

After a while, the envoy of Yan State entered the tent. This envoy was none other than Yan Yi, the general of Yan State that Zhong Yu had met in Feixue Pavilion before.

Yan Yi walked straight into the big tent, bowed his head quickly, and said loudly in a respectful tone. "Yan's envoy, General Yan Yi pays his respects to the Imperial Commander!"

"Emissary Yan doesn't have to be like this, please get up quickly!" Zhong Yu didn't have much intention to embarrass him, he had been fighting for so long now, and he wanted to end this war as soon as possible.

The mobilization of 300,000 troops and the relocation of hundreds of thousands of Yan people cost countless food and salaries. With Yuguo's current material reserves, after experiencing the consumption of Donghu and Jizi North Korea, the two wars, it can't last long.

Hearing the voice in front of him, Yan Yi knew that this was the commander of the 300,000 army, just listening to the voice, he seemed to have heard it somewhere.

However, after receiving the order, Yan Yi quickly got up and looked up at the coach in front of him. After seeing it, he was startled. Isn't this person the one he saw in Feixue Pavilion before? The two also clashed.

"You...you...you are not..." Seeing Zhong Yu sitting on the main seat, Yan Yi raised his left hand and pointed at him and said intermittently.

"Bold, how dare you treat His Royal Highness King Jing of our kingdom so rudely. You are really rude. You should step back and apologize, otherwise, hum!" Seeing Yan Yi's surprised face, Zhong Yu just Laughing, did not speak. However, Jia Xu, who joined the army under him, quickly stood up and cooperated with him in this play.

"Yes, the guilty minister Yan Yi offended His Highness Prince Jing, and I hope that His Highness Prince Jing will forgive him!" After being reminded by Jia Xu, Yan Yi immediately knew how disrespectful he had just done, and quickly knelt down and kowtowed to plead guilty.

It's just that Yan Yi muttered in his heart, didn't he meet this person before Feixue Pavilion? Both myself and Yan Chunjun almost lost their lives in his hands. Moreover, he also obtained from himself and Lord Yanchun the Seal Tiger Talisman to mobilize the imperial army, which led to the current situation of the imperial kingdom.

"General Yan doesn't have to be like this, get up quickly, the lonely king won't be too concerned about blaming small things!" Zhong Yu smiled, and something was happening in his heart.

"Yes, your majesty is magnanimous, and the courtiers of the Yan Kingdom pay homage to you!" Yan Yi said hastily when he heard the man in front of him speak, as if he didn't care about his faux pas just now.

"I don't know His Royal Highness Prince Jing, but the commander of this army? Can he decide the major issues of Yan Yu's exchanges?" After a moment of hesitation, Yan Yi decided to ask. I just heard these people say that the person in front of me is His Royal Highness King Jing of the Yu Kingdom. Could it be that he is the master of the Yu Kingdom? But why is he not called Yuwang, but Jingwang?

At this time, among the seven countries in the world, the monarchs of all countries are called kings, not emperors, and emperors. So it is normal to be willing to have such doubts. After all, looking at the world, there has never been a country with two kings.

"Bold, the person in front of you is the younger brother of His Majesty the Emperor of the Imperial Kingdom. He is in charge of the 100,000 army of the Imperial Kingdom. Now he is in charge of the 300,000 troops who conquered the Yan. He has made great achievements in the Imperial Kingdom and has a high position. He has won the trust of His Majesty the Emperor. Why can't you be the master?" Jia Xu spoke out again at the right time, scolding Yan Yi.

"Emperor... Your Majesty the Emperor? This... this..." Yan Yi pointed at Zhong Yu again, tremblingly asking.

The supreme ruler of the country in front of him is not the so-called king, but the emperor. He only heard about the Three Emperors and Five Emperors, when Qin and Qi became emperors, they were threatened by all the countries in the world and had to revoke the title of emperor. The supreme master of the people in front of him dared to directly call him the title of emperor, it was extremely arrogant and daring.

"Hmph! What I don't know, the territory of our imperial country is tens of thousands of miles, with 200,000 brave men, 400,000 warriors who dare to fight, and 400,000 people who control strings. Such a vast territory, with millions of troops, can be called an emperor. What's the big deal!" Jia Xu snorted coldly and said disdainfully to Yan Yi.
